Tergooi MC | Multiparametric MRI Prostate | 18 January 2025

Clinical indication: Evaluation of elevated PSA (11.0 ng/mL) and clinical suspicion for malignancy.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume measures 46.84 mL. T2-weighted sequences reveal an asymmetric hypointense focus within the right peripheral zone, spanning the mid-gland to the apex, sized roughly 14 x 11 x 12 mm. Diffusion-weighted imaging shows marked restriction alongside correspondingly low ADC values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences demonstrate early, rapid enhancement compared to adjacent parenchyma. There is no evidence of extraprostatic extension, seminal vesicle invasion, suspicious lymphadenopathy, or osseous lesions.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 46.84 mL yielding a PSA density of 0.235 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.4587434
